title: The Upstream Boat
subtitle: Refuse quick fixes, door-to-door sales, flip-to-the-answer pages, and the porch that can be reached in only one step.

trails.title: Trail① Return Exit
trails.description: Bizarre monsters block the captain's path. More... More Abraxas?

items.text: The Upstream Boat
Underground Cave, Island

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Wait a second, ju-just a second!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Isn't this still the dungeon? Are you setting us up?

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: All caves are interconnected. This is the way to our sacred place.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: 37, wait. I remember Sophia once told us that trespassing on the sacred place is a serious crime.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: No worries. The restrictions were to help us not be distracted by the unimportant details in life. It would not stop us from seeking the truth.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ah, excellent. I will tell it to the Abraxas when it shows up.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hmm?!
Regulus suddenly stops.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hey, 37. Are you sure this is the right way? My heart just sank, as if I took a bite of those overnight potato chips.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Are you scared?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oh, you wish! But when I was exploring underground with Lilya earlier ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: We ran into some fog like this one. It doesn't bring you any wanted guests, mind you.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Hmm. Maybe you were their target because you are an irrational number.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oh, is that so? You integers will be fine then?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Good luck. Don't beg this Pirate for help later.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Hold there. Something is coming out.
Several strange figures emerge in the fog, staggering over.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Hmm?!

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Rooster head with two snakes as its feet. Abraxas? That's weird. Why are they here?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: They're coming for us.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Hah, what did I say? Don't beg ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Regulus, prepare for battle!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Okay, I know! I was just teasing her!
Regulus whistles and charges towards the enemies with excitement.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Ah!
An extreme pain comes from the wrist.
It's the stone bangle, which is radiating burning heat.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The stone bangle is activated? But they are just Abraxas.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Regulus, wait for their attack! Do not kill them!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Wh- ...?! What kind of request is this?!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Listen to me, Regulus, that's of prime importance!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Fine! If it is "prime importance," this Pirate will try her best!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: That's it? I still have ten more songs to play!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: These are not the same kind of Abraxas as we've encountered before. Do they have different varieties?

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Wait, where is Ms. 37?
The answer comes from a distance.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Hey, come on, keep up!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Did she just take off like that while we fought?!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Sneaky little ... We should leave too, Vertin!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Wait a second, Regulus.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Do you sense anything familiar in the fog?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Aha, you bet. This is the first guest room we were put in when we first entered the island.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: No, Captain. This APPLe has the same strange feeling.

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: We saw the rise of Ceres in the same kind of fog, and before that ...

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: That's the same fog in the Olitiau's base.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Ah?! That is to say ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: This fog is the cause of our illusion to see the Ceres and the Abraxas's attack?

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Don't rush to conclusions. Follow 37 first.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Oh, and what's that Ceres you were talking about?
The fog gets thicker and thicker, yet the surroundings are becoming brighter and brighter.
As if there's an invisible light source hidden in the fog.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I just picked up a piece of paper.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Like this, just bend over and reach to the ground.
Regulus bends down and reaches for a flicker of light in the darkness.
When she straightens up again, there's a classic manuscript in her hand.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: What book is it?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Humph, probably just some maths problems left from the critters' breakfast. You never know ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Wait, The Compounds of Alchemy: The Twelve Gates Leading to the Discovery of the Philosopher’s Stone ...

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: This is that alchemy handbook given to Edward Ⅳ by George Ripley! Why is it here?!

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Look at this, Captain. Of the Great Stone of the Ancients by Basil Valentine, The One Hundred and Twelve Books by Geber, Emerald Tablet in Latin ...

items.speaker: APPLe
items.text: Seems like there are more ancient texts about alchemy hidden inside the hole. But they are all incomplete.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: So maybe I need to crack some more crossword puzzles to find out about this.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Our caves endow people with "wisdom."

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: All secret knowledge is hidden in the silent boulder walls.
Without getting anyone's attention, 37 has gone to the other side of the cave.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: The knowledge in those books is just a drop in the ocean.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Follow me, Regulus.
But Regulus puts aside the manuscript and hesitates.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Vertin, you lot go ahead. Go with 37. I will meet you outside.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: You want to read these books here?

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: The knowledge passed down through language can easily be distorted. Compared to the wisdom of Apeiron, it's nothing.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: No. I'm not going to stay here. I'm going back.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Oh, alright. I might as well just admit that your cave indeed has the power to give people insights.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: If I follow its lead, perhaps I'll finally work out the answer about that "little thing" I've been carrying with me.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Never thought that I'd find the answer here, easy as picking up a shell on the beach!
37 stops and tilts her head in confusion.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: What? You don't want to get closer to the truth?

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Of course, I do!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: And that's precisely why I don't want to get to it so easily!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I don't want it to be fed into my brain!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Come on, it's the ultimate truth that we're talking about!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: If someone just tells me the ending of Lord of the Flies before I enjoy the book, I will throw them into the sea, as you people do!
She suddenly smiles.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: I only met two people who rejected the truth.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: So this is the mindset of irrational numbers? I see.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Thank you for being my subject of observation, Regulus.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Huh?
But 37 has walked away.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Go, Vertin. We have a long way ahead.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: Be careful, Regulus.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Don't worry, I know this place well enough by now. After all, I've never been so "welcomed" in any other place ever.

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Critters, monsters, creatures with strange heads, do your worse! This Pirate is not afraid of you!
TO BE CONTINUED…
